einzeiler: Discussion on Michael Jordan's 1998 jersey valuation and sports memorabilia.

They analyze the market for game-worn memorabilia versus trading cards. Additionally, they examine the Topps flagship football release, affordable wax products, and iconic cards like the 1989 Upper Deck Ken Griffey Jr. rookie.

beschreibung:
Could Michael Jordan’s 1998 Finals jersey really be worth over $15 million?
Ryan Alford, Brian Ludden and Bella Shafer break down the upcoming sale, debate what the jersey is actually worth, and discuss whether game-worn memorabilia is becoming an even bigger part of the collectibles market. Their predictions range from $25 million to more than $40 million.
They also take a hard look at the new Topps flagship football release, discuss whether affordable wax can still deliver an exciting ripping experience, revisit the iconic 1989 Upper Deck Ken Griffey Jr. rookie, and talk modern chase cards, Frozen Fractors, Minions, SPs and SSPs.
Topics Covered
Michael Jordan’s 1998 Finals jersey
The $100 million valuation debate
Game-worn memorabilia vs. cards
Topps flagship football
Hit rates and affordable wax
1989 Upper Deck Ken Griffey Jr.
Kyrie Irving Frozen Fractor
Modern inserts and chase cards
SP/SSP scarcity
